_comment: Copy this file to capability_profile.json and fill it in with YOUR skills. This is the one file LeadsAgent scores tasks against. See the fields guide below or the README for details. (The .example.json is the template; capability_profile.json is gitignored so your real profile stays private.)

identity.niche: <ONE-LINE: what you do, e.g. 'logo designer for indie SaaS' or 'Vietnamese-English translator'>
identity.tagline: <ONE SENTENCE: your positioning, appears in DM openers>

code.pitch_angle: <one line: what you bring + a real example URL>

portfolio.label: <short label>
portfolio.url: <real URL - GitHub, Behance, published article, shop>

rails.note: <your country/region constraint, e.g. 'SEA-based; PayPal/Wise/USDT work; no US-bank-only rails'>

honesty_gaps: <be specific: 'no existing audience', 'new reddit account (1 karma)', 'no US bank account', etc.>
tos_skips: anything that smells like fraud, impersonation, or spam
